review_notes: I reviewed the whole file. The only new definition is `sobolevPhase`, which is multiplication by a unit-modulus scalar, bundled as `FourierL2 →ₗᵢ[ℂ] FourierL2`. I looked in Mathlib for an existing bundled scalar-multiplication linear isometry indexed by `Circle`. The closest match is the `SMul (unitary 𝕜) (V ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] W)` instance in Mathlib/Analysis/RCLike/Basic.lean. That instance is not a drop-in replacement. It acts on `≃ₗᵢ` rather than `→ₗᵢ`, it is indexed by `unitary 𝕜` rather than `Circle`, and using it would still need `LinearIsometryEquiv.refl` plus conversions. `sobolevPhase` is also a named API used by the later lemmas and by the `Continuous` uncurry statement. The other declarations are lemmas about the equation, not definitions, so they fall outside this rubric. I found no competing concept. One minor uncertainty is that I did not check how `Circle` and `unitary ℂ` relate beyond this search.
